statement: For a Wronskian with N=d(n−d) distinct real projective roots, the points of its fibre in Gr(d,n) are labelled by standard tableaux of rectangle (n−d)^d. For endpoints with distinct absolute root values, continuation along a generic real root path acts by the tableau sliding operation of Definition 3.2.

answer.text: For a Wronskian with N=d(n−d) distinct real projective roots, the points of its fibre in Gr(d,n) are labelled by standard tableaux of rectangle (n−d)^d. For endpoints with distinct absolute root values, continuation along a generic real root path acts by the tableau sliding operation of Definition 3.2.

source.location: Theorem 3.5, printed p. 11; Remark 3.7, printed pp. 13–14

notes:
This describes the real-rooted monodromy groupoid, not a claim that the full complex monodromy group is symmetric. The theorem also treats skew shapes, with additional exclusions at 0 and infinity.

Remark 3.7 describes the cyclic-root-loop action by sliding the smallest entry through the tableau to become the largest.
scope: Monodromy groupoid of finite Wronski map on Gr(d,n), with real-rooted Wronski polynomials.
